title: REQ · A typed useUiStore hook is exported for components to import
summary: uiStore.ts exports useUiStore, UiState and ModalId types usable with selectors.
description: Context: components need a typed entry point. Desired behavior: uiStore.ts exports UiState, ModalId and useUiStore so selector calls like useUiStore(s => s.drawerOpen) are typed. Expected result: importing works under tsc --noEmit. Why: type-safe consumption by later shell work.
acceptance_criteria: Given a component, when it calls useUiStore(s => s.soundEnabled), then it renders the current boolean value
Given the store state changes, when an action runs, then subscribed components re-render with the new value

out_of_scope: Refactoring existing components to use it
